senses.gloss:
रण् रण् (thought by some to be deve-
loped out of a base रम्णा, fr. rt. रम्),
cl. 1. P. (Ved. also cl. 4. P.) रणति (रण्यति),
रराण, अराणीत् (Ved. forms रारण or in Pada-
pāṭha ररण, रणिष्टन्), रणितुम्, to rejoice,
exult; to take pleasure in (with loc., rarely with acc.,
Ved.); to delight (Ved.); to sound, ring, rattle,
jingle; to shout: Caus. P. A. रणयति, रणयते,
यितुम्, Aor. अरीरणत् or अरराणत् (Ved. forms
रारणत्, अरारणुस्, रारन्धि, रारन्तु, ररा-
णत), to cause to rejoice; cause to be pleased,
delight; to rejoice or be pleased at, delight in (with
loc., Ved.); to make to sound, cause to sound forth;
to praise; to go (P.): Desid. रिरणिषति: Intens.
रंरण्यते, रंरण्टि; [cf. Hib. ran, ‘a squeal,
roar;’ ranach, ‘a roaring.’]

रण, अस्, m. joy, delight, gratification, pleasure
(Ved.); sound, noise; the quill or bow of a lute;
going, motion; (अस्, अम्), m. n. battle, war, combat,
fight, conflict.
—रण-कर्मन्, अ, n. ‘war-busi-
ness,’ war, battle, combat, fighting.
—रण-कामिन्,
ई, इनी, इ, desirous of war, wishing to fight.
—रण-
काम्य, Nom. P. -काम्यति, &c., to wish for battle.
—रण-कारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. causing battle or
strife.
—रण-कृत्, त्, त्, त्, causing joy, gratifying,
delighting (Ved.); fighting, a fighter, combatant,
warrior.
—रण-क्षित्ति, इस्, f. or रण-क्षेत्र, अम्,
n. or रण-क्षोणि, इस्, f. place of battle, battle-field.
—रण-गोचर, अस्, आ, अम्, engaged in war, fight-
ing.
—रण-जय, अस्, m. victory in battle.
—र-
णञ्-जय, अस्, m. (रणम्, acc. c.), N. of a king.
—रण-तूर्य, अम्, n. a war-drum, military drum.
—रण-दर, अस्, m. a proper N.
—रण-दुन्-
दुभि, इस्, m. a military drum.
—रण-दुर्गाधा-
रण-यन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a particular amulet.
—रण-पण्डित, अस्, m. ‘skilled in battle,’ a
warrior.
—रण-पुर-स्वामिन्, ई, m., N. of a
certain statue of Sūrya.
—रण-प्रिय, अस्, आ, अम्,
battle-loving, fond of war or battle, warlike; (अस्),
m. a falcon; (अम्), n. the fragrant root of Andro-
pogon Muricatus.
—रण-भट, अस्, m. a proper
N.
—रण-भू, ऊस्, or रण-भूमि, इस्, f. a battle-
ground, field of battle.
—रण-मत्त, अस्, आ, अम्,
furious in battle; (अस्), m. an elephant.
—रण-
मार्ग-कोविद, अस्, आ, अम्, experienced in the art
or ways of war.
—रण-मुख, अम्, n. the front
or van of battle; the van of an army.
—रण-
मुष्टि, इस्, m. a species of plant (= विष-मुष्टि).
[]
—रण-मूर्धन्, आ, m. the front or van of a
fight.
—रण-रङ्क, अस्, m. the space between the
tusks of an elephant.
—रण-रङ्ग, अस्, m. ‘battle-
stage,’ a place or field of battle.
—रणरङ्ग-
मल्ल, अस्, m. = भोज-राज, q. v.
—रण-रण,
अस्, m. ‘the buzzer,’ a gnat, musquito; (अम्), n. a
longing, anxious desire; regret (for a lost object).
—रण-रणक, अस्, अम्, m. n. anxiety, anxious
regret for some beloved object; desire, love; (अस्),
m. the god of love.
—रण-लक्ष्मी, ईस्, f. the
fortune of war; the goddess of battle.
—रण-
वन्य, अस्, m., N. of a king.
—रण-वाद्य, अम्,
n. a military instrument of music, martial music.
—रण-विशारद, अस्, आ, अम्, skilled in war.
—रण-वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, having war or battle for a
profession.
—रण-शिक्षा, f. the art or science of
war.
—रण-शिरस्, अस्, n. the head or front of a
battle.
—रण-शूर, अस्, m. a hero in war, warrior.
—रण-संरम्भ, अस्, m. the fury of battle.
—रण-सङ्कुल, अम्, n. the confusion or noise of
battle, a melée, mixed or tumultuary combat.
—र-
ण-सज्जा, f. military accoutrement.
—रण-सत्त्र,
अम्, n. war or battle regarded as a sacrifice.
—रण-
सहाय, अस्, m. ‘war-helper,’ an ally.
—रण-स्तम्-
भ, अस्, m. ‘battle-pillar,’ a monument of war or
battle, trophy, column; N. of a country (Chitore?).
—रण-स्थान, अम्, n. a battle-place, field of
battle.
—रण-स्वामिन्, ई, m., N. of a statue of
Śiva as lord of battle.
—रणाग्नि (˚ण-अग्˚), इस्, m.
the fire of battle, battle regarded as fire.
—रणाग्र
(˚ण-अग्˚), अम्, n. the head or front of a battle.
—रणाङ्ग (˚ण-अङ्˚), अम्, n. ‘war-implement,’
weapon of war or battle, any weapon, a sword.
—रणाङ्गन (˚ण-अङ्˚), अम्, n. a battle-place,
field of battle, (also रणाङ्गण.)
—रणाजि (˚ण-
आजि), इस्, m., N. of a Sādhya.
—रणाजिर (˚ण-अज्˚),
अम्, n. area or arena for fighting, battle-field.
—र-
णातोद्य (˚ण-आत्˚), अम्, n. a battle-drum, military
drum.
—रणादित्य (˚ण-आद्˚), अस्, m., N. of a king
of Kaśmīra; of another person.
—रणान्त-कृत्
(˚ण-अन्˚), त्, m. ‘making an end of battle,’ N. of
Viṣṇu.
—रणापेत (˚ण-अप्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, flying
away from battle (Kirāt. XV. 33).
—रणाभियोग
(˚ण-अभ्˚), अस्, m. engaging in battle, warlike en-
counter.
—रणारम्भा (˚ण-आर्˚), f., N. of the
wife of Raṇāditya.
—रणारम्भा-स्वामि-देव, अस्,
m., N. of a statue erected by Raṇārambhā.
—र-
णालङ्करण (˚ण-अल्˚), अस्, m. a heron (= कङ्क).
—रणावनि (˚ण-अव्˚), इस्, f. battle-ground, a field
of battle.
—रणाश्व (˚ण-अश्˚), अस्, m., N. of a
king.
—रणे-चर, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, going or mov-
ing about in the field of battle (said of Viṣṇu).
—रणेश (˚ण-ईश) or रणेश्वर (˚ण-ईश्˚), अस्,
m. = रण-स्वामिन्.
—रणे-स्वच्छ, अस्, m. a cock.
—रणैषिन् (˚ण-एस्˚), ई, इणी, इ, eager for battle.
—रणोत्कट (˚ण-उत्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, furious or mad
in battle; (अस्), m., N. of one of Skanda's attendants;
of a Daitya.
—रणोत्साह (˚ण-उत्˚), अस्, m. prowess
in battle.
—रणोद्दाम (˚ण-उद्˚), अस्, आ, अम्,
eager for battle.
—रणोद्देश (˚ण-उद्˚), अस्, m. a
field of battle; a part or quarter of a battle.

राण राण, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. रण्),
a leaf; a peacock's tail; (अस्), m. a proper N.
रणक, अस्, m., N. of a king.

राणक राणक, N. of a commentary by
Someśvara Bhaṭṭa on the Tantra-vārttika; (अस्), m.,
N. of an author; (इका), f. a bridle.
राणाक राणाक, अस्, m. a proper N.

रणित, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded, sounding, rattling;
(अम्), n. sound, any ringing or rattling sound.

रणितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. rejoicing in, delighting
in, (Sāy. = रमण-शील.)

रण्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. agreeable, enjoyable,
delightful, pleasant; fit for fighting, warlike; (अम्),
n., Ved. joy, pleasure; war, battle.
—रण्य-जित्, त्,
त्, त्, Ved. conquering in battle, victorious in war.
—रण्य-वाच्, क्, क्, क्, Ved. speaking agreeably.
रण्य रण्य, रण्व, &c. See p. 829, col. 3.

रण्व, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. pleasant, delightful, agree-
able, lovely; joyous, gay; sounding; to be praised,
worthy of praise.
—रण्व-सन्दृश्, क्, क्, क्, Ved.
looking lovely, appearing beautiful, (Sāy. = रम-
णीय-दर्शन.)

रण्वन्, in Ṛg-veda V. 44, 10, according to Sāy.
= रमणीय, agreeable, pleasant.

रण्ड रण्ड, अस्, आ, अम् (in Uṇādi-s. I. 113.
said to be fr. rt. रम्), mutilated, maimed, crippled,
(incorrect for वण्ड, q. v.); faithless (in शाखा-
रण्ड, q. v.); (अस्), m. a man who dies without
male issue; a barren tree; (आ), f. a term of abuse
in addressing women, a slut; a widow, (बाल-रण्डा,
a young widow); Salvinia Cucullata; N. of a species
of metre.
—रण्डाश्रमिन् (˚ड-आश्˚), ई, m. one who
loses a wife after the forty-eighth year.
रण्डक, अस्, m. a barren tree.

रण्व् रण्व् (= rts. रम्ब्, रिण्व्, रिम्ब्), cl.
1. P. रण्वति, to go; (a form रण्व् for
rt. रण् occurs in Taittrīya-s. I. 2, 5, 1, where, accord-
ing to the commentator, रण्वतु = रमयतु.)

रण्वित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. रण्व् for rt. रण्), in
Ṛg-veda II. 3, 6. according to Sāy. = शब्दित,
स्तुत, sounded, praised, or गच्छत्, going.
राणड्य राणड्य, अस्, m., N. of Dāmodara.

राणायन राणायन, अस्, m. a patronymic
from Raṇa.
—राणायनी-पुत्र, अम्, n., N. of a
preceptor.

राणायनीय, अस्, m., N. of a preceptor; (आस्),
m. pl. the school of Rāṇāyana; (अम्), n. the Sūtras
of Rāṇāyana.
राणायनीयि, इस्, m., N. of a preceptor.
राणि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Rāṇa.

राणिग राणिग, अस्, m., N. of the father of
Jayāditya and uncle of Keśavārka.

राण्ड्य राण्ड्य or रान्द्र्य (according to
Sāy. on Ṛg-veda VI. 23, 6) = रमणीय, agreeable,
gratifying.
